scope: unweighted electron_sector/eS2o on variation shard 1. 3D Bayesian phi_h, 424 fitted cells, Q2-y 1-17. RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, and 5D are absent and were not created. No publication. 28 empty histograms are N/A, including (3,4), (3,5), (4,7), (4,8).
start_mode: manual. Spline B windows are tight (median width 0.020, 945 of 1390 narrower than 0.05), so --use_spline_init was not used. Changed bins are in refine_init.py, a copy of nominal_init.py.
changed: Initial run_shard was not treated as finished. 10 bins were trapped by a small first-pass moment start: the second pass only moves a parameter halfway, so A(1+B cos phi+C cos 2phi) was too flat. Starts were moved to the histogram cosine and limits that excluded it were widened in refine_init.py. Remade Q2-y 1 3 6 9 13 14 16 17 with --unfolding_3D --fit_corrections Bayesian --fit_error_source histogram --fit_init_file, no pass cap and no chi-squared stop. All 10 improved. Worst (9,19) 9.60 to 2.07. Other cells in those Q2-y bins did not move, and unselected Q2-y bins are unchanged. JSON still has 424 cells. The shared manual initializer and the universal spline file were not edited.
left_bins: No 5D family, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. Histogram shapes that disagree with a neighbor were kept, including (6,11) B -0.224 beside neighbor -0.439; (13,9) B -0.175 beside neighbor -0.385; (16,22) B -0.248 beside neighbor -0.082; (9,19) B -0.242 beside neighbor -0.407.
